_note: Registry of RETIRED skills. The repository no longer ships any *-ARCHIVED folder:
OpenClaw rescans the skills folder constantly and logs an error for every folder it
cannot load, so a retired folder on a box is noise forever. Two things read this file:
update-skills.sh moves the old LIVE copy of each key's skill (key minus the -ARCHIVED
suffix) out of the skills folder into <root>/retired-skills/, and scripts/onboarding-state.sh
drops that skill's stale onboarding-state key. scripts/remove-archived-skills.sh moves any
leftover NN-name-ARCHIVED folder from a box's skills folder into <root>/retired-skills/ on every roll.
tests/unit/archived-skill-tombstones.test.py enforces this file: every key ends in
-ARCHIVED, names a successor that exists at the repository root, and carries the commit
that last shipped the folder; no *-ARCHIVED folder may exist at the repository root.
To restore a retired skill, read it back from that commit, for example:
A folder that never came from the repo (for example one made by hand on a box) is not in this
registry; it is restored by moving it back from <root>/retired-skills/ into the skills folder.
